detail: Old creative 1798373404620924 (shared with ad 120253320128010058, which gets its own new creative) -> new creative 969584708912152. It is a full copy of object_story_spec page/IG ids, threads_user_id, and asset_feed_spec: 2 images, 2 placement customization rules (FB+IG story/reels, default), labels on body/title/description/link, LEARN_MORE, AUTOMATIC_FORMAT, additional_data. It also copies degrees_of_freedom_spec (83 features, all OPT_OUT) and creative_sourcing_spec destination_screenshot OPT_OUT. The original had no url_tags. After the update: configured_status=ACTIVE (unchanged), effective_status=IN_PROCESS (re-review). Meta appended a date-hash suffix to the creative name (name dedupe).
